name: exact-archive-to-development-provenance-attribution
purpose: Build the collision index required by every future acquisition and test whether exact byte/RGB collisions can restore immutable codex identity for a material share of the 9990 authorized development rows.

council.decision: Run a local exact archive attribution audit as v13; archives remain exclusion/collision evidence only and no exclusion may change in this iteration.

single_factor.name: exact archive collision evidence added to previously unidentified development rows

hash_contract.byte_sha256: SHA256 of the exact uncompressed ZIP member bytes
hash_contract.decoded_rgb_sha256: SHA256(width as 8-byte big endian || height as 8-byte big endian || RGB bytes), identical to scripts/autoresearch_provenance_v8.py
hash_contract.zip_crc_verified: Every supported member is fully read through zipfile before hashing
hash_contract.image_safety: Keep Pillow decompression-bomb safeguards enabled and record every decode failure
hash_contract.archive_index_checkpoint: One deterministic JSONL plus hash-pinned sidecar per archive; valid sidecars may be reused

codex_mapping_contract.evidence: Exact casefolded equality between a ZIP member filename stem and an elements.csv cote; no fuzzy title inference
codex_mapping_contract.unique_archive_to_codex: An archive maps to a codex only when all exact cote hits identify exactly one codex id
codex_mapping_contract.ambiguous_or_zero_hit_archives: Remain technical archive identities and cannot confer business manuscript identity
codex_mapping_contract.row_attribution: A retained row gains codex identity only when its byte and/or decoded RGB hash identifies exactly one archive and that archive maps to exactly one codex

hypothesis: Exact archive collisions uniquely attribute at least half of the 9990 retained development rows to at least 20 immutable codex identities, materially repairing the zero business-identity coverage observed in v8.

decision_bands.material_recovery: coverage >= 0.5 and at least 20 codex ids; submit facts to Council before any separate exclusion review
decision_bands.partial_recovery: 0 < coverage < 0.5 or fewer than 20 codex ids; preserve index for collision screening but do not revise v12 exclusions
decision_bands.no_recovery: coverage == 0; preserve index and proceed to institutional/shadow metadata sourcing

forbidden_actions: Use any archive image as promotion-test data
Train or fine-tune any model on archive contents
Reopen any of the nine v12 exclusions in this iteration
Lower the v12 threshold from 42 to 41
